prior_threads.reason: The treasure is still unfound. Uriah plans to copy the map, Father William added the witch's house and the Barrow Mound to it, and the party means to check a marked location on the way north.

The question of what the Clurichen does at night is answered: Naggeneen drinks stolen booze (beat_19, beat_21). He is now captive in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_22, beat_23), his offer of a pot of gold or a secret still stands, and Quinn's plans for him are unknown.
The hunt's shape changed. The dragon reportedly can only be killed with Brandon's sword (beat_55), it will soon fly (beat_64), and George doubts Eric has the 1000 gold bounty (beat_66).
Lady Hilda is only seen at the adventurers' table, and Sir Phidipaldi's promise to return to her still stands.
Ned is only seen at the table; his offer is not taken up or withdrawn.
Shipments still have not arrived, and the cause remains unknown.
Dunk offered 20 gold, and Gill said he would lower his price when his boys return. No deal was made.
Dunk saw that the shirt is magical and now plans to get it (beat_47), turning interest into a heist. Ingrid's nightly watching (beat_35) largely answers why Warwick is paranoid.
The thief turned out to be Naggeneen, not Bentley (beat_21). Quinn paid the party 33 gold each (beat_22), so the help was given and paid for and nothing remains owed.

new_threads.name: Squints and the Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Trout recruited Squints on terms that promise him second pick of the first treasure (beat_43). That promise is still owed, and Trout privately said the party would not rescue him (beat_87).

new_threads.name: Dunk's sleeping-potion scheme with Ingrid
new_threads.reason: Dunk wants Ingrid to unlock Warwick's door for him (beat_36) and told the party he has a plan to get the armor (beat_47), which states that this scheme serves the mithril shirt. He gave her diluted faun wine (beat_83), the potion is not yet made, and he will meet her tonight.

new_threads.name: Brandon's sword at the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Father William says the dragon cannot be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_55), so getting it serves the dragon hunt. The party is walking to the Barrow, and the rescued Brother Dirk is reluctant to continue (beat_95).

new_threads.name: Uriah's promise to Father William
new_threads.reason: Father William marked the map in return, and Uriah's agreement to do penance at the Barrow Mound and donate 10 gold for upkeep (beat_60) is still unfulfilled.

new_threads.name: The giant in the northern woods
new_threads.reason: The party stole Brother Dirk from the man-eating giant's stew pot and outran him (beat_92). The giant is unharmed and still lives on the route north.

standalone_beats.reason: Ingrid's wares, including witch powder that reveals magic, are available resources tied to no thread.
Father William offers to heal Uriah if he is injured.
Ingrid says fairies are coming out more since the dragon appeared, and she visits her friend Vivian in the forest.
Ingrid's friend Vivian is a witch living in the woods.
Uriah bought wolfsbane and mandrake root tea.
